```ts
// server/test/history-derive.test.ts: node derivation through REAL sweep ticks (spec 2026-10-05 §6.1 span rule
// and forks, §6.2 `nodes` and the producer, §7.4 items 1, 2, 6-10; W1-B2 plan Task 8, and Task 9 appends). Each
// describe builds one fixture HOME, plants sessions and transcripts in the measured row shapes
// (historyFixtures.ts's compactionSequence), spools the SessionStart line the hook would, and runs sweep.mjs as
// the shim would; the cases then read the store read-only. Linux only (O24): it spawns the sweep.
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll } from 'vitest';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {
  makeHistoryBox, runSweep, plantSession, plantTranscript, spoolLine, openStoreRO, counters, skipOnDarwin,
  type HistoryBox,
} from './historyHelpers.js';
import { compactionSequence, steeredBlock, userRow, type Row } from './historyFixtures.js';
import {
  leafId, historyPaths, NODE_PARSER_VERSION, GIST_MAX, NATIVE_GIST_MAX, TOPIC_CHARS, beltWidth,
} from '../../ccd/history/lib.mjs';
import { createStore, openWriter, closeWriter, withTx, getStep, setStep } from '../../ccd/history/store.mjs';

skipOnDarwin();

const SLUG = '-home-u-worktrees-p-quiet-basin';
const GEN = '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000aa';
/** A day before now: every boundary's raw-leaf grace (lib RAW_LEAF_GRACE_MS) is long past whatever day the suite
 *  runs, so a file read to its end is final. */
const T0 = Date.now() - 86_400_000;
type Seq = ReturnType<typeof compactionSequence>;

/** One session: its registry rows, its transcript under `account`'s projects/, and the SessionStart(startup) line
 *  the hook spools. Its `reg` equals its sid, so the drain confirms the epoch on the line's own evidence. */
function plant(box: HistoryBox, id: string, uuid: string, rows: readonly Row[], account = 'claude'): void {
  plantSession(box, id, { uuid, generation: GEN, project: 'demo', workdir: '/home/u/worktrees/p/quiet-basin' });
  plantTranscript(box, account, SLUG, uuid, [...rows]);
  spoolLine(box, id, { v: 1, ev: 'SessionStart', id, sid: uuid, src: 'startup', reg: uuid, gen: GEN });
}

/** Scheduled passes, as the timer runs them. The first creates the store and renames the spool files; the next
 *  drains them (the epochs confirm) and derives; one more lets every boundary meet its readiness. */
function settle(box: HistoryBox, passes = 3): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < passes; i += 1) {
    const r = runSweep(box);
    expect(r.code, r.stderr).toBe(0);
  }
}

function q<T>(box: HistoryBox, sql: string, ...args: (string | number)[]): T[] {
  const db = openStoreRO(box);
  try { return db.prepare(sql).all(...args) as T[]; } finally { db.close(); }
}

interface LeafRow {
  node_id: string; kind: string; status: string; gist: string | null; topics: string | null;
  summary_blob_id: number | null; span_start_uuid: string; boundary_uuid: string; ord: number;
}
const leavesOf = (box: HistoryBox, uuid: string): LeafRow[] => q<LeafRow>(box,
  `SELECT n.node_id, n.kind, n.status, n.gist, n.topics, n.summary_blob_id, n.span_start_uuid, e.uuid AS boundary_uuid, b.ord
   FROM nodes n JOIN boundaries b ON b.entry_id = n.boundary_entry_id JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = b.entry_id
   JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_pk = n.transcript_pk
   WHERE t.cc_session_uuid = ? AND n.depth = 0 ORDER BY b.ord`, uuid);
const sourcesOf = (box: HistoryBox, nodeId: string): string[] => q<{ uuid: string }>(box,
  'SELECT e.uuid FROM node_sources ns JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = ns.entry_id WHERE ns.node_id = ? ORDER BY ns.ord', nodeId)
  .map((r) => r.uuid);
const blobOf = (box: HistoryBox, uuid: string): number | null =>
  q<{ blob_id: number }>(box, 'SELECT blob_id FROM entries WHERE uuid = ?', uuid)[0]?.blob_id ?? null;
/** Leaf k's sources by construction (§6.1; Task 5's DM5). */
const expectedSources = (s: Seq, k: number): string[] => [
  ...(k === 0 ? [] : [...s.keptUuids[k - 1]!, ...s.afterUuids[k - 1]!]),
  ...s.workUuids[k]!, ...s.unkeptUuids[k]!,
];
const firstUuid = (s: Seq): string => String(s.rows[0]!['uuid']);
const withDirection = (s: Seq, direction: 'from' | 'up_to'): Row[] =>
  s.rows.map((r) => (r['uuid'] === s.summaryUuids[0] ? { ...r, summarizeMetadata: { direction } } : r));

const UNCLOSED = (): string => [
  '<analysis>', 'Reviewing the unclosed fixture.', '</analysis>',
  '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   The unclosed fixture.',
  '8. Current Work:', '   Unclosed current work runs to the end of the row.',
  '9. Optional Next Step:', '   Unclosed next step.',
].join('\n');
/** The GPT shape (§7.4 item 8, RG12): a surviving second <analysis>, then two unclosed <summary> opens, each with
 *  both closing headings. */
const GPT_SHAPED = (): string => [
  '<analysis>', 'A first analysis, closed.', '</analysis>',
  '<analysis>', '8. Current Work:', '   ANALYSIS current work inside the surviving analysis.',
  '<summary>', '8. Current Work:', '   FIRST current work.', '9. Optional Next Step:', '   FIRST next step.',
  '<summary>', '8. Current Work:', '   SECOND current work.', '9. Optional Next Step:', '   SECOND next step.',
].join('\n');
/** Both closing pairs in one summary, so only the direction can choose (§7.4 item 8). */
const BOTH_PAIRS = (): string => [
  '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   A summary holding both closing pairs.',
  '8. Current Work:', '   CURRENT-PAIR text, which a from summary ends with.',
  '9. Optional Next Step:', '   CURRENT-PAIR next step.',
  '10. Work Completed:', '   COMPLETED-PAIR text, which an up_to summary ends with.',
  '11. Context for Continuing Work:', '   COMPLETED-PAIR context.',
  '</summary>',
].join('\n');
/** A summary QUOTING a block, at a boundary with no steer receipt (§7.4 item 2). */
const QUOTED = (): string => [
  '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   Testing the block parser on a fixture.',
  '8. Current Work:', '   Quoting a fixture block while testing the parser:',
  '<ccrc-leaf id="L0123456789abcdef0123">',
  'gist: A quoted fixture gist that is long enough to pass the forty character floor of the parser.',
  'Expand for details about: quoted, fixture',
  'refs: server/test/history-parser.test.ts',
  '</ccrc-leaf>',
  '9. Optional Next Step:', '   Keep the quoted block as data.',
  '</summary>',
].join('\n');

describe('native leaves through real ticks: summary row, readiness, gist and counters (PX1, PX7, PX25, DM25; spec 7.4)', () => {
  const U = {
    auto: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a1', manual: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a2',
    from: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a3', raw: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a4',
    unclosed: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a5', gpt: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a6',
    upto: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a7', fromDir: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a8',
    quoted: '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000a9',
  };
  let box: HistoryBox;
  let auto: Seq; let manual: Seq; let from: Seq; let raw: Seq;
  beforeAll(() => {
    box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-derive-');
    auto = compactionSequence({ n: 2, trigger: 'auto', seed: 0x81, sessionId: U.auto, startMs: T0 });
    manual = compactionSequence({ n: 2, trigger: 'manual', unkeptBeforeBoundary: 3, seed: 0x82, sessionId: U.manual, startMs: T0 });
    from = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', anchorIsBoundary: true, seed: 0x83, sessionId: U.from, startMs: T0 });
    raw = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', dropSummary: true, seed: 0x84, sessionId: U.raw, startMs: T0 });
    const unclosed = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', summaryText: UNCLOSED, seed: 0x85, sessionId: U.unclosed, startMs: T0 });
    const gpt = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'auto', model: 'gpt-fixture-5', summaryText: GPT_SHAPED, seed: 0x86, sessionId: U.gpt, startMs: T0 });
    const upto = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', summaryText: BOTH_PAIRS, seed: 0x87, sessionId: U.upto, startMs: T0 });
    const fromDir = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', summaryText: BOTH_PAIRS, seed: 0x88, sessionId: U.fromDir, startMs: T0 });
    const quoted = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', summaryText: QUOTED, seed: 0x89, sessionId: U.quoted, startMs: T0 });
    plant(box, 'claude-auto', U.auto, auto.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-manual', U.manual, manual.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-from', U.from, from.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-raw', U.raw, raw.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-unclosed', U.unclosed, unclosed.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-gpt', U.gpt, gpt.rows);
    plant(box, 'claude-upto', U.upto, withDirection(upto, 'up_to'));
    plant(box, 'claude-fromdir', U.fromDir, withDirection(fromDir, 'from'));
    plant(box, 'claude-quoted', U.quoted, quoted.rows);
    settle(box);
  }, 240_000);

  it('PX1 auto: the summary is the anchor row 4 rows after each boundary; each leaf is native, with exact sources and its pre-minted id', () => {
    const leaves = leavesOf(box, U.auto);
    expect(leaves.map((l) => l.boundary_uuid)).toEqual(auto.boundaryUuids);
    leaves.forEach((l, k) => {
      expect({ kind: l.kind, status: l.status }, `leaf ${k}`).toEqual({ kind: 'native_leaf', status: 'not-requested' });
      expect(l.summary_blob_id, `leaf ${k}`).toBe(blobOf(box, auto.summaryUuids[k]!));
      expect(l.gist ?? '', `leaf ${k}`).toContain(`Working on segment ${k} of the fixture.`);
      expect(sourcesOf(box, l.node_id), `leaf ${k}`).toEqual(expectedSources(auto, k));
      expect(l.node_id, `leaf ${k}`).toBe(leafId('claude-auto', U.auto, k === 0 ? firstUuid(auto) : auto.headUuids[k - 1]!));
    });
  });

  it('PX1 manual: the summary is the row right after each boundary; unkept rows stay with their compaction', () => {
    const leaves = leavesOf(box, U.manual);
    expect(leaves).toHaveLength(2);
    leaves.forEach((l, k) => {
      expect(l.summary_blob_id, `leaf ${k}`).toBe(blobOf(box, manual.summaryUuids[k]!));
      expect(sourcesOf(box, l.node_id), `leaf ${k}`).toEqual(expectedSources(manual, k));
    });
  });

  it('PX1 partial from: an anchor naming the boundary itself reads the next isCompactSummary row, counted, never the boundary', () => {
    const [l] = leavesOf(box, U.from);
    expect(l!.kind).toBe('native_leaf');
    expect(l!.summary_blob_id).toBe(blobOf(box, from.summaryUuids[0]!));
    expect(l!.summary_blob_id).not.toBe(blobOf(box, from.boundaryUuids[0]!));
    expect(counters(box)['anchor_is_boundary']).toBe(1);
  });

  it('DM25: a boundary whose anchor names no row is a raw leaf, not-requested, counted summary_missing, its span still navigable', () => {
    const [l] = leavesOf(box, U.raw);
    // §7.4 item 2: with no steer receipt the status is not-requested. `absent` is a block missing from a span that
    // HAD a receipt (item 5), and the compliance counter would read it as a model's miss.
    expect({ kind: l!.kind, status: l!.status, gist: l!.gist, summary: l!.summary_blob_id })
      .toEqual({ kind: 'raw_leaf', status: 'not-requested', gist: null, summary: null });
    expect(sourcesOf(box, l!.node_id)).toEqual(expectedSources(raw, 0));
    expect(counters(box)['summary_missing']).toBe(1);
  });

  it('compliance by status and by reason, by producer (spec 7.4 item 10): every W1 leaf is not-requested, reason no-receipt; none counts absent', () => {
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['leaf_status:not-requested:anthropic']).toBe(10);
    expect(c['leaf_status:not-requested:other']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['leaf_reason:no-receipt:anthropic']).toBe(10);
    expect(c['leaf_reason:no-receipt:other']).toBe(1);
    expect(Object.keys(c).filter((k) => k.startsWith('leaf_status:absent'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('PX7: a summary with no </summary> is scanned whole and counted summary_unclosed under its producer', () => {
    const [l] = leavesOf(box, U.unclosed);
    expect(l!.gist ?? '').toContain('Unclosed current work runs to the end of the row.');
    expect(counters(box)['summary_unclosed:anthropic']).toBe(1);
  });

  it('PX25: a GPT-shaped summary gives the gist from the last occurrence after the last <summary> open, counted under other', () => {
    const [l] = leavesOf(box, U.gpt);
    expect(l!.gist ?? '').toContain('SECOND current work');
    expect(l!.gist ?? '').not.toContain('FIRST current work');
    expect(l!.gist ?? '').not.toContain('ANALYSIS current work');
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['summary_unclosed:other']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['leaf_status:not-requested:other']).toBe(1);
  });

  it("the native pair follows the summary row's summarizeMetadata.direction, read back from its source line", () => {
    const [u] = leavesOf(box, U.upto);
    const [f] = leavesOf(box, U.fromDir);
    expect(u!.gist ?? '').toContain('COMPLETED-PAIR');
    expect(u!.gist ?? '').not.toContain('CURRENT-PAIR');
    expect(f!.gist ?? '').toContain('CURRENT-PAIR');
    expect(f!.gist ?? '').not.toContain('COMPLETED-PAIR');
  });

  it('with no steer receipt a quoted <ccrc-leaf> block is never parsed: the leaf is native and not-requested', () => {
    const [l] = leavesOf(box, U.quoted);
    expect({ kind: l!.kind, status: l!.status }).toEqual({ kind: 'native_leaf', status: 'not-requested' });
    expect(l!.gist ?? '').toContain('Keep the quoted block as data.');
  });

  it('review focus 1: a stored summary in neither section format is a native leaf, not-requested, with no gist; never raw, never a throw', () => {
    const one = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-plain-');
    const PLAIN = 'f1a10000-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
    const seq = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', seed: 0x8a, sessionId: PLAIN, startMs: T0,
      summaryText: () => 'A plain-prose summary of the work so far, with no numbered sections and no summary tags.' });
    plant(one, 'claude-plain', PLAIN, seq.rows);
    settle(one);
    const [l] = leavesOf(one, PLAIN);
    expect({ kind: l!.kind, status: l!.status, gist: l!.gist }).toEqual({ kind: 'native_leaf', status: 'not-requested', gist: null });
    expect(l!.summary_blob_id).toBe(blobOf(one, seq.summaryUuids[0]!));
    expect(counters(one)['parser_crash'] ?? 0).toBe(0);
  }, 120_000);

  it('a summary-less boundary with no time of its own takes the newest stamped row before it, so it still becomes a raw leaf (raw-leaf grace)', () => {
    const one = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-nots-');
    const NOTS = 'f1a10000-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
    const seq = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', dropSummary: true, seed: 0x8b, sessionId: NOTS, startMs: T0 });
    const rows = seq.rows.map((r) => {
      if (r['uuid'] !== seq.boundaryUuids[0]) return r;
      const bare: Row = { ...r };
      delete bare['timestamp'];
      return bare;
    });
    expect(rows.find((r) => r['uuid'] === seq.boundaryUuids[0])!['timestamp'], 'CONTROL: the boundary row carries no time').toBeUndefined();
    plant(one, 'claude-nots', NOTS, rows);
    settle(one);
    const leaves = leavesOf(one, NOTS);
    expect(leaves.map((l) => ({ kind: l.kind, status: l.status }))).toEqual([{ kind: 'raw_leaf', status: 'not-requested' }]);
  }, 120_000);

  it("topics are the list items new since the previous summary's sections 2-3, stored as JSON text", () => {
    const [l0, l1] = leavesOf(box, U.auto);
    const t0 = JSON.parse(l0!.topics ?? 'null') as string[];

    expect(t0.some((t) => t.includes('fixture-concept-0'))).toBe(true);

  it("refs are the Read paths mined from the span's tool_use rows, origin tool_use", () => {
    const [l0] = leavesOf(box, U.auto);
    const refs = q<{ kind: string; value: string; origin: string }>(box, 'SELECT kind, value, origin FROM node_refs WHERE node_id = ? ORDER BY value', l0!.node_id);
    expect(refs.map((r) => r.value)).toContain('/home/u/worktrees/p/quiet-basin/src/segment-0-1.ts');
    for (const r of refs) expect(r.origin).toBe('tool_use');
  });

  it('every leaf has its nodes_fts row once FTS is ready, and the leaves cursor stands at the last boundary', () => {
    const n = q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM nodes')[0]!.n;
    const f = q<{ f: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS f FROM nodes_fts')[0]!.f;
    expect(n).toBe(11);
    expect(f).toBe(n);
    const e = q<{ e: number }>(box, 'SELECT max(entry_id) AS e FROM boundaries')[0]!.e;
    const [step] = q<{ cursor: string }>(box, "SELECT cursor FROM derivation_state WHERE step = 'leaves' AND version = ?", NODE_PARSER_VERSION);
    expect(Number(step!.cursor)).toBe(e);
  });
});

    const stored = new Set(q<{ uuid: string }>(box, 'SELECT uuid FROM entries').map((r) => r.uuid));
    const inLeaves = new Set(q<{ uuid: string }>(box, 'SELECT e.uuid FROM node_sources ns JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = ns.entry_id').map((r) => r.uuid));
    for (const u of sufB.liveUuids) {
      expect(stored.has(u), u).toBe(true);
      expect(inLeaves.has(u), u).toBe(false);
    }
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['rows_unspanned']).toBe(sufB.liveUuids.length);
    expect(c['transcript_forked']).toBe(1);
  });

  it('DM36: rows appended later to the copy that holds no new boundary are counted too, with no leaf derived in that tick', () => {
    const entriesBefore = q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM entries')[0]!.n;
    const nodesBefore = q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM nodes')[0]!.n;
    const p = path.join(box.accountHome['claude-a']!, 'projects', SLUG, `${U}.jsonl`);
    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
      const row = userRow({ uuid: `000000b4-0000-4000-8000-00000000000${i}`, ts: new Date(T0 + 9_000_000 + i * 1000).toISOString(), sessionId: U, text: `a later turn in copy B ${i}` });
      fs.appendFileSync(p, `${JSON.stringify(row)}\n`);
    }
    spoolLine(box, ID, { v: 1, ev: 'Stop', id: ID, sid: U });   // the hint that re-reads both copies
    settle(box);
    expect(q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM entries')[0]!.n, 'CONTROL: copy B was read again').toBe(entriesBefore + 3);
    expect(q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM nodes')[0]!.n, 'CONTROL: no leaf was derived').toBe(nodesBefore);
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['rows_unspanned']).toBe(sufB.liveUuids.length + 3);
    expect(c['transcript_forked'], 'counted once').toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('two forks after one head: the first bound keeps the plain id, the later is boundary-qualified (DM37; spec 6.1)', () => {
  const ID = 'claude-twofork';
  const U = '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000f2';
  let box: HistoryBox;
  let pre: Seq; let sufA: Seq; let sufB: Seq;
  beforeAll(() => {
    box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-dm37-');
    pre = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', seed: 0xa1, sessionId: U, startMs: T0 });
    sufA = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'manual', seed: 0xa2, sessionId: U, startMs: T0 + 600_000 });
    sufB = compactionSequence({ n: 1, trigger: 'auto', seed: 0xa3, sessionId: U, startMs: T0 + 600_000 });
    plantSession(box, ID, { uuid: U, generation: GEN, project: 'demo', workdir: '/home/u/worktrees/p/quiet-basin' });
    plantTranscript(box, 'claude', SLUG, U, [...pre.rows, ...sufA.rows]);
    plantTranscript(box, 'claude-a', SLUG, U, [...pre.rows, ...sufB.rows]);
    spoolLine(box, ID, { v: 1, ev: 'SessionStart', id: ID, sid: U, src: 'startup', reg: U, gen: GEN });
    settle(box);
  }, 240_000);

  it('DM37: all three boundary rows exist, with distinct ord', () => {
    const rows = q<{ uuid: string; ord: number }>(box, 'SELECT e.uuid, b.ord FROM boundaries b JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = b.entry_id ORDER BY b.ord');
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.uuid)).toEqual([pre.boundaryUuids[0], sufA.boundaryUuids[0], sufB.boundaryUuids[0]]);
    expect(new Set(rows.map((r) => r.ord)).size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('DM37: the first bound keeps the plain id, the second takes the boundary-qualified id; leaf_id_forked +1', () => {
    const byBoundary = new Map(leavesOf(box, U).map((l) => [l.boundary_uuid, l]));
    const head = pre.headUuids[0]!;
    const a = byBoundary.get(sufA.boundaryUuids[0]!)!;
    const b = byBoundary.get(sufB.boundaryUuids[0]!)!;
    expect(a.node_id).toBe(leafId(ID, U, head));
    expect(b.node_id).toBe(leafId(ID, U, head, sufB.boundaryUuids[0]!));
    expect(b.span_start_uuid).toBe(head);
    expect(sourcesOf(box, b.node_id)).toEqual([
      ...pre.keptUuids[0]!, ...pre.afterUuids[0]!, ...pre.liveUuids, ...sufB.workUuids[0]!, ...sufB.unkeptUuids[0]!,
    ]);
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['leaf_id_forked']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['transcript_forked']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['rows_unspanned'] ?? 0, 'each copy holds a boundary, so every row is in a holding copy').toBe(0);
  });

  it('DM37: a re-ingest mints neither id again', () => {
    const before = q<{ node_id: string }>(box, 'SELECT node_id FROM nodes ORDER BY node_id').map((r) => r.node_id);
    const entriesBefore = q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM entries')[0]!.n;
    ['claude', 'claude-a'].forEach((acct, i) => {
      const p = path.join(box.accountHome[acct]!, 'projects', SLUG, `${U}.jsonl`);
      const row = userRow({ uuid: `000000a4-0000-4000-8000-00000000000${i + 1}`, ts: new Date(T0 + 9_000_000).toISOString(), sessionId: U, text: `a later turn in copy ${i}` });
      fs.appendFileSync(p, `${JSON.stringify(row)}\n`);
    });
    spoolLine(box, ID, { v: 1, ev: 'Stop', id: ID, sid: U });   // the hint that re-reads both copies
    settle(box);
    const entriesAfter = q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM entries')[0]!.n;
    expect(entriesAfter, 'CONTROL: both copies were read again').toBe(entriesBefore + 2);
    expect(q<{ node_id: string }>(box, 'SELECT node_id FROM nodes ORDER BY node_id').map((r) => r.node_id)).toEqual(before);
    expect(counters(box)['leaf_id_forked']).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('a carried copy of an earlier gist is invalid even past the cap (spec 7.4 items 2, 5, 6, 10; IN-6)', () => {
  const ID = 'claude-carried';
  const U = '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000f4';
  /** One gist longer than GIST_MAX, which the next summary's block carries word for word. */
  const LONG = `Carried fixture gist that runs past the cap. ${'carried words '.repeat(110)}`.trim();
  const steered = (): string => [
    '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   A steered fixture summary.', '</summary>',
    steeredBlock({ gist: LONG, expand: 'carried, fixture', refs: 'server/test/history-derive.test.ts' }),
  ].join('\n');
  let box: HistoryBox;
  beforeAll(() => {
    box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-carried-');
    const seq = compactionSequence({ n: 2, trigger: 'manual', summaryText: steered, seed: 0xa5, sessionId: U, startMs: T0 });
    plant(box, ID, U, seq.rows);
    // Two generic steer receipts, one inside each leaf's window (the previous boundary, this boundary].
    const at = (u: string): number => Date.parse(String(seq.rows.find((r) => r['uuid'] === u)!['timestamp']));
    for (const b of seq.boundaryUuids) spoolLine(box, ID, { v: 1, ev: 'steer', id: ID, sid: U, leaf: '', ts: at(b) - 500 });
    settle(box);
  }, 240_000);

  it('leaf 0 is steered and cut at GIST_MAX; leaf 1 carries that gist and is invalid, counted carried_copies and by its reason', () => {
    expect(LONG.length, 'CONTROL: the carried gist is longer than the cap').toBeGreaterThan(GIST_MAX);
    const [l0, l1] = leavesOf(box, U);
    expect({ kind: l0!.kind, status: l0!.status, gist: l0!.gist }).toEqual({ kind: 'steered_leaf', status: 'ok', gist: LONG.slice(0, GIST_MAX) });
    expect({ kind: l1!.kind, status: l1!.status }).toEqual({ kind: 'native_leaf', status: 'invalid' });
    const c = counters(box);
    expect(c['carried_copies']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['leaf_reason:carried-copy:anthropic']).toBe(1);
    expect(c['leaf_status:ok:anthropic']).toBe(1);
    expect(Object.keys(c).filter((k) => k.startsWith('leaf_reason:')), 'an ok leaf has no reason; both spans had a receipt')
      .toEqual(['leaf_reason:carried-copy:anthropic']);
  });
});

describe('a registered value is redacted before any derived field is cut: gist, topic and ref, steered and native (review R30; spec 8.3, 7.4 items 6-8)', () => {
  // Leaf 0 is steered (one generic receipt in its window): its block's gist holds V across GIST_MAX, one of its
  // topics holds V across TOPIC_CHARS, and its refs line names a path holding V. One of its span's Read rows
  // reads a path holding V, so a mined ref holds V too. Leaf 1 is native: V across NATIVE_GIST_MAX in its Current
  // Work, and across TOPIC_CHARS in a section-2 item. V is PAIR-ONLY when the leaves are derived. The first ticks
  // record its pair from a secret file, which is then rewritten without it, so redact_hashes keeps the pair and no
  // belt unit holds V (Task 7A's belt holds the values loaded now). That is the rotated-value shape, and a
  // sessions.json hash behaves the same. Only the pair, matched on the WHOLE run before any cut, can mask V. A cut
  // first leaves a prefix that no pair matches, which no later layer (nodeIndexTexts included) can mask.
  const ID = 'claude-redact';
  const U = '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000f5';
  const V = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');   // one [A-Za-z0-9_-] run: one pair; beltWidth 18
  /** `n` characters of one filler run, no whitespace, so every position below is exact. */
  const fill = (n: number): string => 'zqfill-'.repeat(Math.ceil(n / 7)).slice(0, n);
  const LEAD = 30;   // V characters a cut-first derivation would keep: at least beltWidth(V)
  const GIST = `${fill(GIST_MAX - LEAD - 1)} ${V} zqsteer tail words`;
  const TOPIC = `${fill(TOPIC_CHARS - LEAD - 1)} ${V} more`;
  const CURRENT_LABEL = 'Current Work: ';
  const steered = (): string => [
    '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   A steered fixture summary for the redaction order.', '</summary>',
    steeredBlock({ gist: GIST, expand: `zqtopic plain, ${TOPIC}`, refs: `src/${V}/model.ts server/test/history-derive.test.ts` }),
  ].join('\n');
  const native = (): string => [
    '<summary>', '1. Primary Request and Intent:', '   A native fixture summary for the redaction order.',
    '2. Key Technical Concepts:', `   - ${TOPIC}`,
    '8. Current Work:', `   ${fill(NATIVE_GIST_MAX - CURRENT_LABEL.length - LEAD - 1)} ${V} zqnative tail`,
    '9. Optional Next Step:', '   zqnative next step.', '</summary>',
  ].join('\n');
  let box: HistoryBox;
  /** Every text derivation stored for one node: its gist and topics, every node_refs value, its nodes_fts columns. */
  const storedTexts = (nodeId: string): string[] => [
    ...q<{ gist: string | null; topics: string | null }>(box, 'SELECT gist, topics FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?', nodeId)
      .flatMap((r) => [r.gist ?? '', r.topics ?? '']),
    ...q<{ value: string }>(box, 'SELECT value FROM node_refs WHERE node_id = ?', nodeId).map((r) => r.value),
    ...q<{ gist: string | null; topics: string | null; refs: string | null }>(box,
      'SELECT f.gist, f.topics, f.refs FROM nodes_fts f JOIN nodes n ON n.rowid = f.rowid WHERE n.node_id = ?', nodeId)
      .flatMap((r) => [r.gist ?? '', r.topics ?? '', r.refs ?? '']),
  ];
  /** Each text holding beltWidth(v) consecutive characters of `v`, ASCII case folded as the belt folds. Its answer
   *  is a short list, so a red prints no long diff. */
  const stretches = (texts: readonly string[], v: string): string[] => {
    const w = beltWidth(v);
    const low = v.toLowerCase();
    const out: string[] = [];
    texts.forEach((t, i) => {
      const lt = t.toLowerCase();
      for (let k = 0; k + w <= low.length; k += 1) {
        if (lt.includes(low.slice(k, k + w))) { out.push(`#${i}: ${low.slice(k, k + w)}`); break; }
      }
    });
    return out;
  };
  const refsOf = (nodeId: string): { value: string; origin: string }[] =>
    q<{ value: string; origin: string }>(box, 'SELECT value, origin FROM node_refs WHERE node_id = ? ORDER BY value', nodeId);
  const ftsRowsOf = (nodeId: string): number => q<{ c: number }>(box,
    'SELECT count(*) AS c FROM nodes_fts f JOIN nodes n ON n.rowid = f.rowid WHERE n.node_id = ?', nodeId)[0]!.c;

  beforeAll(() => {
    box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-derive-redact-');
    const dir = path.join(box.home, '.cc-secrets');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const file = path.join(dir, 'x8derive.env');
    fs.writeFileSync(file, `ZQ_DERIVE_V=${V}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i += 1) expect(runSweep(box).code).toBe(0);
    const db = openStoreRO(box);
    try {
      const pair = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS c FROM redact_hashes WHERE len = ? AND sha256 = ?')
        .get(V.length, crypto.createHash('sha256').update(V).digest()) as { c: number };
      expect(pair.c, 'CONTROL: the first ticks recorded the pair').toBe(1);
    } finally { db.close(); }
    fs.writeFileSync(file, `ZQ_DERIVE_OTHER=${crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex')}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    const seq = compactionSequence({
      n: 2, trigger: 'manual', workRows: 8, seed: 0xc8, sessionId: U, startMs: T0, summaryText: (k) => (k === 0 ? steered() : native()),
    });
    // Leaf 0's first Read (segment-0-1.ts) reads a path holding V; its second (segment-0-5.ts) is the mined CONTROL.
    const rows = seq.rows.map((r) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(r).replace('quiet-basin/src/segment-0-1.ts', `quiet-basin/src/${V}/mined.ts`)) as Row);
    expect(rows.filter((r) => JSON.stringify(r).includes(`/${V}/mined.ts`)), 'CONTROL: one Read row holds V').toHaveLength(1);
    plant(box, ID, U, rows);
    const at = (u: string): number => Date.parse(String(rows.find((r) => r['uuid'] === u)!['timestamp']));
    // One generic receipt, inside leaf 0's window only (leaf 1's window opens after boundary 0).
    spoolLine(box, ID, { v: 1, ev: 'steer', id: ID, sid: U, leaf: '', ts: at(seq.boundaryUuids[0]!) - 500 });
    settle(box);
  }, 240_000);

  it('the steered leaf: the gist and the topic hold the mark where V sat across the cut; no stored field holds a belt-width stretch of V', () => {
    const [l0] = leavesOf(box, U);
    expect({ kind: l0!.kind, status: l0!.status }, 'CONTROL: leaf 0 is steered').toEqual({ kind: 'steered_leaf', status: 'ok' });
    expect(GIST.indexOf(V), 'CONTROL: V straddles GIST_MAX').toBe(GIST_MAX - LEAD);
    expect(l0!.gist!.slice(GIST_MAX - LEAD, GIST_MAX - LEAD + 10), 'redacted, then cut').toBe('[redacted]');
    expect(JSON.parse(l0!.topics!) as string[], 'redacted, then cut').toContain(`${fill(TOPIC_CHARS - LEAD - 1)} [redacted] more`);
    const refs = refsOf(l0!.node_id);
    expect(refs, 'CONTROL: the model refs were read').toContainEqual({ value: 'server/test/history-derive.test.ts', origin: 'model' });
    expect(refs, 'CONTROL: the span was mined').toContainEqual({ value: '/home/u/worktrees/p/quiet-basin/src/segment-0-5.ts', origin: 'tool_use' });
    expect(ftsRowsOf(l0!.node_id), 'CONTROL: the node has its nodes_fts row').toBe(1);
    expect(stretches(storedTexts(l0!.node_id), V)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('the native leaf: its gist and topic hold the mark where V sat across the cut; no stored field holds a belt-width stretch of V', () => {
    const [, l1] = leavesOf(box, U);
    expect({ kind: l1!.kind, status: l1!.status }, 'CONTROL: leaf 1 is native').toEqual({ kind: 'native_leaf', status: 'not-requested' });
    // The native gist is `Current Work: ` and the section's text, so V starts at NATIVE_GIST_MAX - LEAD.
    const at = NATIVE_GIST_MAX - LEAD;
    expect(l1!.gist!.slice(0, CURRENT_LABEL.length), 'CONTROL: the Current Work pair').toBe(CURRENT_LABEL);
    expect(l1!.gist!.slice(at, at + 10), 'redacted, then cut').toBe('[redacted]');
    expect(JSON.parse(l1!.topics!) as string[], 'redacted, then cut').toContain(`${fill(TOPIC_CHARS - LEAD - 1)} [redacted] more`);
    expect(ftsRowsOf(l1!.node_id), 'CONTROL: the node has its nodes_fts row').toBe(1);
    expect(stretches(storedTexts(l1!.node_id), V)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('a parser throw is recorded, counted once and never parsed again by a tick (RB5; NEW history-parser-crash-recorded)', () => {
  const ID = 'claude-crash';
  const U = '0189abcd-1234-4678-9abc-0000000000f3';
  type Kit = { HEADING_RE: RegExp; fencedRanges(t: string): unknown; mineTokens(w: string, re: RegExp | null): unknown };
  type Derived = { derived: number; waiting: number; failed: number };
  let box: HistoryBox;
  let seq: Seq;
  beforeAll(() => {
    box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-crash-');
    seq = compactionSequence({ n: 3, trigger: 'manual', seed: 0xb1, sessionId: U, startMs: T0 });
    plant(box, ID, U, seq.rows);
    settle(box);
  }, 240_000);

  type Writer = ReturnType<typeof openWriter>;
  const write = (fn: (db: Writer) => void): void => {
    const db = openWriter(historyPaths(box.home).dbFile);
    try { withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { fn(db); }); } finally { closeWriter(db); }
  };
  /** Delete one node and what references it, as a test only does: its nodes_fts row, its refs; node_sources cascade. */
  const dropNode = (db: Writer, id: string): void => {
    if (db.prepare("SELECT 1 AS x FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'nodes_fts'").get() !== undefined) {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM nodes_fts WHERE rowid = (SELECT rowid FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?)').run(id);
    }
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM node_refs WHERE node_id = ?').run(id);
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?').run(id);
  };
  const entryOf = (uuid: string): number => q<{ entry_id: number }>(box, 'SELECT entry_id FROM entries WHERE uuid = ?', uuid)[0]!.entry_id;
  const crashes = (): number => counters(box)['parser_crash'] ?? 0;
  const atBoundary = (entryId: number) => q<{ node_id: string; kind: string; status: string; gist: string | null; topics: string | null; summary_blob_id: number | null }>(box,
    'SELECT node_id, kind, status, gist, topics, summary_blob_id FROM nodes WHERE boundary_entry_id = ? ORDER BY node_id', entryId);
  /** One in-process derivation pass, as the tick runs it, with `kit` as the node toolkit (an in-process seam: the
   *  sweep never sets ictx.nodeKit). */
  async function derive(kit: (real: Kit) => Kit): Promise<Derived> {
    const S = (await import('../../ccd/history/sweep.mjs')) as unknown as {
      makeIngestCtx(home: string, homes: string[], nowMs: number, ids: unknown): Record<string, unknown>;
      newBudget(): unknown;
    };
    const D = (await import('../../ccd/history/derive.mjs')) as unknown as {
      nodeToolkit(): Kit;
      deriveLeaves(db: Writer, ictx: Record<string, unknown>, budget: unknown): Derived;
    };
    const db = openWriter(historyPaths(box.home).dbFile);
    try {
      const ictx = S.makeIngestCtx(box.home, box.homes, Date.now(), null);
      ictx['nodeKit'] = kit(D.nodeToolkit());
      return D.deriveLeaves(db, ictx, S.newBudget());
    } finally {
      closeWriter(db);
    }
  }

  it('a throw inside the parser writes the leaf parse-failed under its own id and sources; a throw before the leaf leaves a marker; the next pass parses neither', async () => {
    const [l0, l1, l2] = leavesOf(box, U);
    expect([l0, l1, l2].every((l) => l !== undefined && l.kind === 'native_leaf'), 'CONTROL: three native leaves').toBe(true);
    expect(crashes(), 'CONTROL: the ticks crashed nothing').toBe(0);
    const src1 = sourcesOf(box, l1!.node_id);
    const [b0, b1, b2] = seq.boundaryUuids.map(entryOf);
    const forkedId = leafId(ID, U, seq.headUuids[1]!, seq.boundaryUuids[2]!);
    write((db) => {
      dropNode(db, l1!.node_id);
      dropNode(db, l2!.node_id);
      // Boundary 2's plain id now names boundary 0 and its fork-qualified id is taken: its insert can only fail.
      const plantNode = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO nodes (node_id, session_pk, epoch_seq, transcript_pk, kind, depth, status,
          boundary_entry_id, parser_version, created_ms)
        SELECT ?, session_pk, epoch_seq, transcript_pk, 'raw_leaf', 0, 'not-requested', ?, parser_version, created_ms FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?`);
      plantNode.run(l2!.node_id, b0!, l0!.node_id);
      plantNode.run(forkedId, null, l0!.node_id);
      db.prepare("DELETE FROM derivation_state WHERE step = 'leaves'").run();
    });
    const throwing = (real: Kit): Kit => ({ ...real, fencedRanges: () => { throw new Error('a planted parser bug'); } });
    expect(await derive(throwing)).toEqual({ derived: 1, waiting: 0, failed: 1 });
    expect(await derive(throwing), 'the next pass parses neither boundary again').toEqual({ derived: 0, waiting: 0, failed: 0 });
    expect(crashes(), 'each throw counted once').toBe(2);
    expect(atBoundary(b1!)).toEqual([{
      node_id: l1!.node_id, kind: 'raw_leaf', status: 'parse-failed', gist: null, topics: null,
      summary_blob_id: blobOf(box, seq.summaryUuids[1]!),
    }]);
    expect(sourcesOf(box, l1!.node_id), 'its own sources, as derived before').toEqual(src1);
    expect(q<{ n: number }>(box, 'SELECT count(*) AS n FROM node_refs WHERE node_id = ?', l1!.node_id)[0]!.n).toBe(0);
    expect(atBoundary(b2!), 'no leaf at the boundary whose insert failed').toEqual([]);
    expect(q<{ cursor: string }>(box, "SELECT cursor FROM derivation_state WHERE step = 'leaf-crashed' AND version = ?", b2!))
      .toEqual([{ cursor: String(NODE_PARSER_VERSION) }]);
    const [leaves] = q<{ cursor: string }>(box, "SELECT cursor FROM derivation_state WHERE step = 'leaves' AND version = ?", NODE_PARSER_VERSION);
    expect(Number(leaves!.cursor), 'the cursor moved past both').toBe(b2);
    expect(Object.keys(counters(box)).filter((k) => k.includes('parse-failed')), 'a crash is no compliance outcome').toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a summary row stored but unreadable (a tombstoned blob) makes a raw leaf that still names its summary, counted summary_unreadable (spec 6.1)', async () => {
    const id0 = leafId(ID, U, firstUuid(seq));
    const b0 = entryOf(seq.boundaryUuids[0]!);
    const blob0 = blobOf(box, seq.summaryUuids[0]!)!;
    const doomed = atBoundary(b0).map((n) => n.node_id);   // leaf 0, and the node the case above planted there
    write((db) => {
      for (const n of doomed) dropNode(db, n);
      db.prepare('UPDATE blobs SET z = NULL, pruned_ms = ? WHERE blob_id = ?').run(Date.now(), blob0);
      db.prepare("DELETE FROM derivation_state WHERE step = 'leaves'").run();
    });
    expect(await derive((k) => k)).toEqual({ derived: 1, waiting: 0, failed: 0 });
    expect(atBoundary(b0)).toEqual([{ node_id: id0, kind: 'raw_leaf', status: 'not-requested', gist: null, topics: null, summary_blob_id: blob0 }]);
    expect(counters(box)['summary_unreadable']).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('the derivation toolkit and the derivation_state helpers (in-process)', () => {
  it("nodeToolkit hands lib the card's own heading rule, fence scanner and token miner", async () => {
    const D = (await import('../../ccd/history/derive.mjs')) as unknown as {
      nodeToolkit(): {
        HEADING_RE: RegExp;
        fencedRanges(t: string): { ranges: Array<[number, number]>; closed: number };
        mineTokens(w: string, re: RegExp | null): Array<{ token: string; tag: string }>;
      };
    };
    const kit = D.nodeToolkit();
    expect(kit.HEADING_RE.flags).toBe('gm');
    expect([...'8. Current Work:\n'.matchAll(new RegExp(kit.HEADING_RE.source, kit.HEADING_RE.flags))].map((m) => m[1])).toEqual(['Current Work']);
    expect(kit.fencedRanges('a\n```\n1. x\n```\nb')).toEqual({ ranges: [[2, 15]], closed: 1 });
    const line = JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', message: { content: [{ type: 'tool_use', name: 'Read', input: { file_path: '/home/u/a.ts' } }] } });
    expect(kit.mineTokens(line, null)).toEqual([{ token: '/home/u/a.ts', tag: 'touched' }]);
  });

  it('getStep and setStep: one derivation_state row per (step, version), the cursor kept apart from completed_ms', () => {
    const box = makeHistoryBox('ccrc-hist-step-');
    createStore(box.home);
    const db = openWriter(historyPaths(box.home).dbFile);
    try {
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 1)).toBeNull();
      withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { setStep(db, 'leaves', 1, '41'); });
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 1)).toEqual({ cursor: '41', completedMs: null });
      withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { setStep(db, 'leaves', 1, '42', 1_700_000_000_000); });
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 1)).toEqual({ cursor: '42', completedMs: 1_700_000_000_000 });
      withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { setStep(db, 'leaves', 1, '43'); });
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 1), 'an omitted completedMs leaves it').toEqual({ cursor: '43', completedMs: 1_700_000_000_000 });
      withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { setStep(db, 'leaves', 1, null, null); });
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 1)).toEqual({ cursor: null, completedMs: null });
      expect(getStep(db, 'leaves', 2), 'another version is another row').toBeNull();
    } finally {
      closeWriter(db);
    }
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Write `ccd/history/derive.mjs`.** Create it with exactly this content:

```js
// ccd/history/derive.mjs: node derivation inside the sweep's tick (spec 2026-10-05 §6.1 span rule and forks,
// §6.2 `nodes` and the producer, §6.3, §7.4; W1-B2 plan Tasks 8 and 9).
//
// L4 delivery. It reads the store and, for one field, the source line a summary row came from, and hands every
// decision to lib.mjs (L1): planSpans, summaryRowFor, pickHoldingCopy, leafReady, decideLeafId, pickReceipt, the
// block parser and the native gist, forkCounts. It imports ../compact-card.mjs for the card's heading rules and
// token miner and injects them into lib as a toolkit (§6.4), so lib.mjs stays node:crypto-only. sweep.mjs imports
// this module, and this module imports nothing of the sweep back: the sweep helpers it needs (admitFile,
// budgetLeft, isBusy) arrive on the ingest context. It reads no environment. An in-process test may set
// ictx.nodeKit to replace the toolkit (history-test-seams-not-env); the sweep never sets it.
//
// Nodes are DERIVED: a rebuild re-derives every leaf with the same id from entries, memberships and boundaries
// (§6.1, §9.14), so nothing here journals. Each leaf commits in its own NORMAL transaction.
import { closeSync, readSync } from 'node:fs';
import { HEADING_RE, fencedRanges, mineTokens } from '../compact-card.mjs';
import {
  LINE_MAX, NODE_PARSER_VERSION, blobOverDecodeCap, blockFields, blockStatus, capRefs, classifyRef, decideLeafId, directionOfSummaryRow,
  directiveFlag, eofAfterBoundary, forkCounts, ftsTextOf, gistSha, leafId, leafReady, nativeGist, nativeTopics, nodeIndexTexts,
  parseBlocks, pickHoldingCopy, pickReceipt, planSpans, producerOfCopy, redactField, selectBlock, summaryParts,
  summaryRowFor,
} from './lib.mjs';
import { bump, getStep, setStep, unbrotli, withTx } from './store.mjs';

/** derivation_state steps this module keeps (§6.2). None is the 'recover' step status reads. */
const LEAF_STEP = 'leaves';                   // version NODE_PARSER_VERSION; cursor: every boundary at or below it has its leaf or a LEAF_CRASHED_STEP marker
const UNSPANNED_STEP = 'rows-unspanned';      // version = transcript_pk; cursor: '<rows_unspanned folded>:<live bytes read then>'
const FORKED_STEP = 'transcript-forked';      // version = transcript_pk; present once transcript_forked is counted
const LEAF_CRASHED_STEP = 'leaf-crashed';     // version = boundary entry_id; cursor: the NODE_PARSER_VERSION it crashed under (RB5)
/** A summary's source line is read in pieces this size, never past LINE_MAX. */
const LINE_PIECE = 64 * 1024;

const DERIVE_STMTS = new WeakMap();
const NODES_FTS_STMTS = new WeakMap();

/** The prepared statements, one set per connection. Each names its columns. A row's copies are found through
 *  (file_id, entry_id), the memberships primary key: v1 has no index on entry_id alone, on purpose. `todo` and
 *  `firstTodo` take (low, LEAF_CRASHED_STEP, String(NODE_PARSER_VERSION)): a boundary with a crash marker at this parser
 *  version is not to do (RB5). */
function stmts(db) {
  let s = DERIVE_STMTS.get(db);
  if (s !== undefined) return s;
  s = {
    todo: db.prepare(`SELECT b.entry_id AS entry_id, e.uuid AS uuid, e.ts_ms AS ts_ms, b.transcript_pk AS transcript_pk,
        t.cc_session_uuid AS cc_uuid
      FROM boundaries b JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = b.entry_id JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_pk = b.transcript_pk
      WHERE b.entry_id > ? AND t.agent_id = ''
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.boundary_entry_id = b.entry_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM derivation_state d WHERE d.step = ? AND d.version = b.entry_id AND d.cursor = ?)
      ORDER BY b.entry_id`),
    firstTodo: db.prepare(`SELECT min(b.entry_id) AS e FROM boundaries b JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_pk = b.transcript_pk
      WHERE b.entry_id > ? AND t.agent_id = ''
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.boundary_entry_id = b.entry_id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM derivation_state d WHERE d.step = ? AND d.version = b.entry_id AND d.cursor = ?)`),
    lastBoundary: db.prepare(`SELECT max(b.entry_id) AS e FROM boundaries b JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_pk = b.transcript_pk
      WHERE t.agent_id = ''`),
    epochOf: db.prepare(`SELECT e.session_pk AS session_pk, e.seq AS seq, s.ccrc_id AS ccrc_id
      FROM epochs e JOIN sessions s ON s.session_pk = e.session_pk
      WHERE e.cc_session_uuid = ? AND e.confirmed_ms IS NOT NULL AND s.merged_into IS NULL
      ORDER BY e.session_pk LIMIT 1`),
    files: db.prepare('SELECT file_id, eof_ms, source_key FROM ingest_files WHERE transcript_pk = ? ORDER BY file_id'),
    liveFiles: db.prepare("SELECT file_id FROM ingest_files WHERE transcript_pk = ? AND source_key = '' ORDER BY file_id"),
    member: db.prepare('SELECT 1 AS hit FROM memberships WHERE file_id = ? AND entry_id = ?'),
    copySize: db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM memberships WHERE file_id = ?'),
    /** Distinct rows over a JSON list of file_ids: the union of some copies, counted in SQLite, never in a JS Set. */
    rowsIn: db.prepare('SELECT count(DISTINCT entry_id) AS n FROM memberships WHERE file_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))'),
    /** Main transcripts with two or more live copies, and the bytes read from them: the ones whose fork counts can
     *  change, and the cheap measure of whether they did. */
    forkCandidates: db.prepare(`SELECT f.transcript_pk AS transcript_pk, sum(f.offset) AS bytes
      FROM ingest_files f JOIN transcripts t ON t.transcript_pk = f.transcript_pk
      WHERE f.source_key = '' AND t.agent_id = ''
      GROUP BY f.transcript_pk HAVING count(*) > 1`),
    copyRows: db.prepare(`SELECT m.line AS line, e.entry_id AS entry_id, e.uuid AS uuid, e.type AS type,
        e.provenance AS provenance, e.is_compact_summary AS is_compact_summary, e.ts_ms AS ts_ms, e.model AS model,
        e.tool_name AS tool_name, e.blob_id AS blob_id, bl.raw_len AS raw_len,
        CASE WHEN b.entry_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_boundary, b.head_uuid AS head_uuid,
        b.anchor_uuid AS anchor_uuid, b.kept_blob_id AS kept_blob_id
      FROM memberships m JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = m.entry_id JOIN blobs bl ON bl.blob_id = e.blob_id
      LEFT JOIN boundaries b ON b.entry_id = e.entry_id
      WHERE m.file_id = ? ORDER BY m.line`),
    memberLine: db.prepare(`SELECT m.line AS line, e.uuid AS uuid FROM memberships m JOIN entries e ON e.entry_id = m.entry_id
      WHERE m.file_id = ? AND m.entry_id = ?`),
    blobZ: db.prepare('SELECT z FROM blobs WHERE blob_id = ?'),
    blobLen: db.prepare('SELECT raw_len FROM blobs WHERE blob_id = ?'),
    paths: db.prepare('SELECT path FROM file_paths WHERE file_id = ? ORDER BY path'),
    receipts: db.prepare('SELECT leaf_id, ts_ms FROM steer_receipts WHERE cc_session_uuid = ? ORDER BY ts_ms, event_key'),
    nodeBound: db.prepare('SELECT boundary_entry_id FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?'),
    priorGists: db.prepare('SELECT node_id, gist FROM nodes WHERE session_pk = ? AND depth = 0 AND gist IS NOT NULL'),
    leafBoundaries: db.prepare('SELECT boundary_entry_id FROM nodes WHERE transcript_pk = ? AND depth = 0 AND boundary_entry_id IS NOT NULL'),
    insNode: db.prepare(`INSERT INTO nodes (node_id, session_pk, epoch_seq, transcript_pk, kind, depth, status, gist, topics,
        summary_blob_id, boundary_entry_id, span_start_uuid, earliest_ms, latest_ms, src_chars, desc_count, desc_chars,
        directive_flag, capped, parser_version, created_ms)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?)`),
    insSource: db.prepare('INSERT INTO node_sources (node_id, entry_id, ord) VALUES (?, ?, ?)'),
    insRef: db.prepare(`INSERT INTO node_refs (node_id, kind, value, origin) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT (node_id, kind, value) DO NOTHING`),
    nodeRowid: db.prepare('SELECT rowid AS r FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ?'),
  };
  DERIVE_STMTS.set(db, s);
  return s;
}

/** The card's heading rules and token miner, as lib's native gist and refs take them (§6.4). lib never imports
 *  compact-card.mjs; it receives this. */
export function nodeToolkit() {
  return Object.freeze({ HEADING_RE, fencedRanges, mineTokens });
}

/** The two lookups node derivation and the read verbs make by a column no v1 index covers: a boundary's leaf,
 *  and a child's parent. Created by derivation, as the FTS tables are (§9.1), so no schema migration (which every
 *  real store would escalate to snapshot-needs-op, §6.11) is spent on them. D-4703 (history-node-indexes-by-derivation) */
export function ensureNodeIndexes(db) {
  db.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS nodes_boundary ON nodes(boundary_entry_id)');
  db.exec('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS node_children_child ON node_children(child_id)');
}

/** One line from `offset`, without its '\n'; null when no '\n' falls within LINE_MAX bytes or before EOF. */
function readLineAt(fd, offset, size) {
  const parts = [];
  let got = 0;
  for (let pos = offset; pos < size && got < LINE_MAX;) {
    const want = Math.min(LINE_PIECE, size - pos, LINE_MAX - got);
    const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(want);
    const n = readSync(fd, buf, 0, want, pos);
    if (n === 0) break;
    const nl = buf.subarray(0, n).indexOf(0x0a);
    if (nl >= 0) {
      parts.push(buf.subarray(0, nl));
      return Buffer.concat(parts).toString('utf8');
    }
    parts.push(buf.subarray(0, n));
    got += n;
    pos += n;
  }
  return null;
}

/** A summary row's `summarizeMetadata.direction`, read back from its own line in the copy that holds it (§7.4
 *  item 8): the store keeps the row's message only. The file is opened through the sweep's own admission
 *  (O_NOFOLLOW, a regular file, realpath under a rostered projects/ root), the line read at its membership's byte
 *  offset, bounded at LINE_MAX, and believed only when its uuid is the row's. Anything else is null: the pair then
 *  follows the text. D-4704 (history-summary-direction-from-source-line) */
export function summaryDirectionOf(db, ictx, summaryEntryId, fileId) {
  const s = stmts(db);
  const m = s.memberLine.get(fileId, summaryEntryId);
  if (m === undefined) return null;
  for (const { path: p } of s.paths.all(fileId)) {
    const home = ictx.homes.find((h) => p.startsWith(`${h}/`));
    if (home === undefined) continue;
    const a = ictx.admitFile(p, home, ictx.homes, ictx.home);
    if (!a.ok) continue;
    try {
      let text;
      try { text = readLineAt(a.fd, Number(m.line), Number(a.st.size)); } catch { return null; }
      if (text === null) return null;
      let row;
      try { row = JSON.parse(text); } catch { return null; }
      return row !== null && typeof row === 'object' && row.uuid === m.uuid ? directionOfSummaryRow(row) : null;
    } finally {
      closeSync(a.fd);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** A stored body, parsed; null for a tombstone (z NULL), a raw-only blob that is not JSON, or a body over B1's
 *  decode cap (or with no measured raw_len), which is never decoded whole. B1's unbrotli needs the stored raw_len as
 *  its bound and throws without it, as B1's own storedBody passes it. The blob's raw_len is read by a statement of
 *  its own so that blobZ keeps the SQL Task 21's fault seam matches. Its compressed bytes count against the run's
 *  byte budget, as the FTS backfill's do. */
function bodyOf(s, blobId, budget) {
  const r = s.blobZ.get(blobId);
  if (r === undefined || r.z === null) return null;
  const rawLen = s.blobLen.get(blobId)?.raw_len;
  if (blobOverDecodeCap(rawLen)) return null;   // B1's history-permanent-failures-classified: an over-cap or unmeasured body is never decoded whole
  budget.bytes += r.z.length;
  try { return JSON.parse(unbrotli(r.z, rawLen).toString('utf8')); } catch { return null; }
}

function textOf(s, blobId, budget) {
  const body = bodyOf(s, blobId, budget);
  return body === null ? null : ftsTextOf(body, 'entry');
}

/** A boundary's kept list (preservedMessages.allUuids, stored as its own blob by B1's ingest), as a set. */
function keptOf(s, blobId, budget) {
  if (blobId === null) return new Set();
  const v = bodyOf(s, blobId, budget);
  return new Set(Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((u) => typeof u === 'string') : []);
}

function epochFor(s, pass, ccUuid) {
  if (!pass.epochs.has(ccUuid)) pass.epochs.set(ccUuid, s.epochOf.get(ccUuid) ?? null);
  return pass.epochs.get(ccUuid);
}

/** The copy that holds boundary `b` (§6.1 "The copy"), decided by lib's pickHoldingCopy over what this measures:
 *  each of the transcript's files, whether it is live (source_key '') and whether it has the boundary row as a
 *  member. Answers that file's ingest_files row ({ file_id, eof_ms, source_key }), or null. Task 9's fan-in and
 *  Task 21's reparse call it too: `pass` needs only `{ files: Map }`, `b` only `{ entry_id, transcript_pk }`. */
function holdingCopy(s, pass, b) {
  let files = pass.files.get(b.transcript_pk);
  if (files === undefined) {
    files = s.files.all(b.transcript_pk);
    pass.files.set(b.transcript_pk, files);
  }
  const fileId = pickHoldingCopy(files.map((f) => ({
    fileId: Number(f.file_id), live: f.source_key === '', holds: s.member.get(f.file_id, b.entry_id) !== undefined,
  })));
  return fileId === null ? null : files.find((f) => Number(f.file_id) === fileId);
}

/** The newest stamped row's time at or before `uuid` in the copy's file order: the boundary's own time when it has
 *  one. lib's raw-leaf grace reads it (D-4690 (history-raw-leaf-grace)); null only when no row up to it has a time. */
function stampAtOrBefore(copy, uuid) {
  for (let i = copy.index.get(uuid); i >= 0; i -= 1) {
    const t = copy.rows[i].ts_ms;
    if (t !== null) return Number(t);
  }
  return null;
}

/** One copy's rows in file order, each of its boundaries' summary pick, and lib's spans over them. Kept for the
 *  next boundary of the same copy, the common case: boundaries come in entry order. */
function copyPlan(s, pass, fileId, budget) {
  if (pass.copy !== null && pass.copy.fileId === fileId) return pass.copy;
  const rows = s.copyRows.all(fileId);
  const index = new Map(rows.map((r, i) => [r.uuid, i]));
  const meta = rows.map((r) => ({ uuid: r.uuid, isCompactSummary: r.is_compact_summary === 1, isEcho: r.type === 'user' && r.provenance === 'harness' }));
  const picks = new Map();
  const boundaries = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.is_boundary !== 1) continue;
    const pick = summaryRowFor({ boundaryUuid: r.uuid, anchorUuid: r.anchor_uuid, rows: meta });
    picks.set(r.uuid, pick);
    boundaries.push({ uuid: r.uuid, headUuid: r.head_uuid, kept: keptOf(s, r.kept_blob_id, budget), summaryUuid: pick.uuid });
  }
  const plan = planSpans({
    rows: rows.map((r) => ({ uuid: r.uuid, pos: Number(r.line), isBoundary: r.is_boundary === 1, isSummary: r.is_compact_summary === 1 })),
    boundaries,
  });
  const copy = { fileId, rows, index, picks, boundaries, leafOf: new Map(plan.leaves.map((l) => [l.boundaryUuid, l])) };
  pass.copy = copy;
  return copy;
}

function previousBoundary(copy, uuid) {
  const k = copy.boundaries.findIndex((x) => x.uuid === uuid);
  return k > 0 ? copy.boundaries[k - 1] : null;
}

/** The previous boundary's summary text in the same copy (nativeTopics compares against it), or null. */
function prevSummaryText(s, copy, uuid, budget) {
  const prev = previousBoundary(copy, uuid);
  if (prev === null || prev.summaryUuid === null) return null;
  const i = copy.index.get(prev.summaryUuid);
  return i === undefined ? null : textOf(s, copy.rows[i].blob_id, budget);
}

function receiptsOf(s, ccUuid) {
  return s.receipts.all(ccUuid).map((r) => ({ leafId: r.leaf_id, tsMs: r.ts_ms }));
}

/** The receipt window of boundary `b` (§7.4 item 2): after the previous boundary of the same copy, up to this one. */
function receiptWindow(copy, b, id) {
  const prev = previousBoundary(copy, b.uuid);
  return { id, afterMs: prev === null ? null : copy.rows[copy.index.get(prev.uuid)].ts_ms, uptoMs: b.ts_ms };
}

/** The refs mined from a span's tool_use rows (§7.4 item 7, origin `tool_use`): compact-card's miner over the
 *  rows' tool_use blocks, cut to the inputs it reads, each token redacted (a ref is stored and indexed) and
 *  classified. With no graph the miner reads Edit-shaped and Read paths only (§6.4). */
function minedRefs(s, kit, sources, pairIdx, budget) {
  const lines = [];
  for (const r of sources) {
    if (r.type !== 'assistant' || r.tool_name === null) continue;
    const body = bodyOf(s, r.blob_id, budget);
    const uses = (Array.isArray(body) ? body : []).filter((x) => x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && x.type === 'tool_use')
      .map((x) => ({ type: 'tool_use', name: x.name, input: { file_path: x.input?.file_path, notebook_path: x.input?.notebook_path, command: x.input?.command } }));
    if (uses.length > 0) lines.push(JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', message: { content: uses } }));
  }
  const out = [];
  for (const { token } of kit.mineTokens(lines.join('\n'), null)) {
    const value = redactField(token, pairIdx);
    const kind = classifyRef(value);
    if (kind !== null) out.push({ kind, value, origin: 'tool_use' });
  }
  return out;
}

/** A node's nodes_fts row, rowid = nodes.rowid (§6.2): its gist, topics and ref values through lib's nodeIndexTexts with
 *  `idx`, the pair index its fields were derived with (W1-B2 Task 7A: B1's escape readings and the belt, so nodes_fts
 *  holds no term blobs_fts masks). Deleted first, so a later backfill or re-derivation of the same node never
 *  duplicates it. */
function indexNode(db, s, id, gist, topics, refs, idx) {
  let f = NODES_FTS_STMTS.get(db);
  if (f === undefined) {
    f = {
      del: db.prepare('DELETE FROM nodes_fts WHERE rowid = ?'),
      ins: db.prepare('INSERT INTO nodes_fts (rowid, gist, topics, refs) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)'),
    };
    NODES_FTS_STMTS.set(db, f);
  }
  const rowid = s.nodeRowid.get(id).r;
  f.del.run(rowid);
  const t = nodeIndexTexts({ gist, topics, refs: refs.map((r) => r.value) }, idx);
  f.ins.run(rowid, t.gist, t.topics, t.refs);
}

/** One leaf's derived fields from its stored summary (§7.4): kind, status and its reason, gist, topics, refs, the
 *  capped and directive flags, the producer and the counters the derivation folds. deriveOne writes them for a new
 *  leaf; W1-B2 Task 21's refreshLeaf rewrites them for an existing one, never its id, span or sources.
 *  - No summary row, or one stored but unreadable (a tombstone, a body that is not JSON): a raw leaf (§6.1), its
 *    summary blob still recorded when the row exists.
 *  - With no steer receipt the status is not-requested, reason no-receipt (§7.4 item 2): `absent` comes only from
 *    blockStatus, on the receipt path. A raw leaf never looks a receipt up.
 *  - A carried copy is counted by blockStatus' own reason. The prior gists are hashed with gistSha, the hash the
 *    block's gist gets, over the stored form; a prior gist of the leaf itself never counts. */
function leafFields(db, ictx, kit, s, copy, b, pick, id, sessionPk, sources, budget) {
  const summaryAt = pick.uuid === null ? undefined : copy.index.get(pick.uuid);
  const summary = summaryAt === undefined ? null : copy.rows[summaryAt];
  const backend = producerOfCopy(copy.rows, summaryAt ?? copy.index.get(b.uuid));
  const counts = [];
  let kind = 'raw_leaf';
  let status = 'not-requested';
  let reason = 'no-receipt';
  let gist = null;
  let topics = null;
  let modelRefs = [];
  let capped = false;
  const text = summary === null ? null : textOf(s, summary.blob_id, budget);
  if (summary === null) {
    counts.push('summary_missing');
  } else if (text === null) {
    counts.push('summary_unreadable');
  } else {
    kind = 'native_leaf';
    topics = [];
    if (summaryParts(text).unclosed) counts.push(`summary_unclosed:${backend}`);
    const receipt = pickReceipt(receiptsOf(s, b.cc_uuid), receiptWindow(copy, b, id));
    let steered = null;
    if (receipt !== null) {
      const blocks = parseBlocks(redactField(text, ictx.pairIdx));
      const sel = selectBlock({ blocks, kind: 'leaf', computedId: id, generic: receipt.leafId === '' });
      const prior = new Set(s.priorGists.all(sessionPk).filter((r) => r.node_id !== id).map((r) => gistSha(r.gist)));
      const verdict = blockStatus({ receipt: true, block: sel.block, idMismatch: sel.idMismatch, priorGistShas: prior });
      status = verdict.status;
      reason = verdict.reason;
      if (sel.idMismatch) counts.push('id_mismatch');
      if (sel.block === null && blocks.some((x) => x.inAnalysis)) counts.push(`analysis_only:${backend}`);
      if (verdict.reason === 'carried-copy') counts.push('carried_copies');
      if (status === 'ok' || status === 'degraded') steered = blockFields(sel.block);
    }
    if (steered !== null) {
      kind = 'steered_leaf';
      gist = steered.gist;
      topics = steered.topics;
      modelRefs = steered.refs;
      capped = steered.capped;
    } else {
      const direction = summaryDirectionOf(db, ictx, summary.entry_id, copy.fileId);
      const g = nativeGist({ text, direction }, kit, ictx.pairIdx);
      const t = nativeTopics({ text, prevText: prevSummaryText(s, copy, b.uuid, budget) }, kit, ictx.pairIdx);
      gist = g.gist;
      topics = t.topics;
      capped = g.capped || t.capped;
    }
  }
  const refs = capRefs([...modelRefs, ...minedRefs(s, kit, sources, ictx.pairIdx, budget)]);
  const flag = gist !== null && directiveFlag([gist, ...(topics ?? [])].join('\n'));
  return { summary, backend, counts, kind, status, reason, gist, topics, refs, capped, flag, crashed: false };
}

/** A leaf whose parser threw (RB5): written under its own id with its span and sources, kind raw_leaf, status
 *  parse-failed, no gist, topics or refs, and its summary row's blob still recorded, so reparse (Task 21) re-derives
 *  it in place. Counted parser_crash once and no compliance outcome. D-4706 (history-parser-crash-recorded) */
function parseFailedFields(copy, pick) {
  const at = pick.uuid === null ? undefined : copy.index.get(pick.uuid);
  return {
    summary: at === undefined ? null : copy.rows[at], backend: null, counts: ['parser_crash'], kind: 'raw_leaf',
    status: 'parse-failed', reason: null, gist: null, topics: null, refs: { refs: [], capped: false }, capped: false,
    flag: false, crashed: true,
  };
}

/** One boundary's leaf (§6.1, §7.4), or why it waits: no confirmed epoch yet (out of every scope), no holding
 *  copy, or not ready (lib leafReady: a raw leaf is never written while it could still be native). The boundary's
 *  time for the raw-leaf grace is its own, or the newest stamped row before it in the holding copy. */
function deriveOne(db, ictx, kit, s, pass, b, budget) {
  const ep = epochFor(s, pass, b.cc_uuid);
  if (ep === null) return 'waiting';
  const holding = holdingCopy(s, pass, b);
  if (holding === null) return 'waiting';
  const copy = copyPlan(s, pass, holding.file_id, budget);
  const leaf = copy.leafOf.get(b.uuid);
  if (leaf === undefined) return 'waiting';
  const pick = copy.picks.get(b.uuid);
  const ready = leafReady({
    summaryStored: pick.uuid !== null,
    fileAtEofAfterBoundary: eofAfterBoundary({ eofMs: holding.eof_ms, boundaryTsMs: stampAtOrBefore(copy, b.uuid) }),
  });
  if (!ready) return 'waiting';
  const plain = leafId(ep.ccrc_id, b.cc_uuid, leaf.spanStartUuid);
  const bound = s.nodeBound.get(plain);
  const plainBoundOther = bound !== undefined && bound.boundary_entry_id !== b.entry_id;
  const { id, forked } = decideLeafId({ ccrcId: ep.ccrc_id, ccUuid: b.cc_uuid, spanStartUuid: leaf.spanStartUuid, boundaryUuid: b.uuid, plainBoundOther });
  const sources = leaf.sources.map((u) => copy.rows[copy.index.get(u)]);
  let f;
  try {
    f = leafFields(db, ictx, kit, s, copy, b, pick, id, ep.session_pk, sources, budget);
  } catch (e) {
    if (ictx.isBusy(e)) throw e;
    // RB5: the parser threw (a bug). The leaf is written anyway, parse-failed, and only reparse re-derives it.
    f = parseFailedFields(copy, pick);
  }
  const { summary, counts, kind, status, reason, gist, topics, refs, capped, flag, backend, crashed } = f;
  let earliest = null;
  let latest = null;
  let srcChars = 0;
  for (const r of sources) {
    if (r.ts_ms !== null && (earliest === null || r.ts_ms < earliest)) earliest = r.ts_ms;
    if (r.ts_ms !== null && (latest === null || r.ts_ms > latest)) latest = r.ts_ms;
    srcChars += Number(r.raw_len);
  }
  withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => {
    s.insNode.run(id, ep.session_pk, ep.seq, b.transcript_pk, kind, status, gist,
      topics === null ? null : JSON.stringify(topics), summary === null ? null : summary.blob_id,
      b.entry_id, leaf.spanStartUuid, earliest, latest, srcChars, flag ? 1 : 0, capped || refs.capped ? 1 : 0,
      NODE_PARSER_VERSION, ictx.nowMs);
    sources.forEach((r, ord) => { s.insSource.run(id, r.entry_id, ord); });
    for (const r of refs.refs) s.insRef.run(id, r.kind, r.value, r.origin);
    if (ictx.fts === true) indexNode(db, s, id, gist, topics, refs.refs, ictx.pairIdx);
    if (forked) bump(db, 'leaf_id_forked');
    if (leaf.headMissing) bump(db, 'head_missing');
    if (summary !== null && pick.anchorIsBoundary) bump(db, 'anchor_is_boundary');
    for (const c of counts) bump(db, c);
    // §7.4 item 10: compliance by status and by reason, each by producer. A parser crash is no outcome.
    if (!crashed) {
      bump(db, `leaf_status:${status}:${backend}`);
      if (reason !== null) bump(db, `leaf_reason:${reason}:${backend}`);
    }
  });
  return 'derived';
}

/** The rows-unspanned cursor: '<rows_unspanned already folded>:<live bytes read when folded>'. No row, or one this
 *  build cannot read, is "never folded". */
function foldedOf(step) {
  const m = step === null || step.cursor === null ? null : /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*):(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.exec(step.cursor);
  return m === null ? { unspanned: 0, bytes: null } : { unspanned: Number(m[1]), bytes: Number(m[2]) };
}

/** A main transcript's fork counters (§6.1), from lib's forkCounts over what this measures on its LIVE copies:
 *  - rows_unspanned: rows no holding copy has (they join no leaf), folded as the increase over the count already
 *    recorded;
 *  - transcript_forked: once, when it has two or more live copies and none holds every row.
 *  The holding copy of each leaf's boundary is lib's pickHoldingCopy among the live copies. `bytes` is the live
 *  copies' bytes read now, kept beside the folded count so the next tick knows whether to recount. */
function recountTranscript(db, s, transcriptPk, nowMs, bytes) {
  const live = s.liveFiles.all(transcriptPk).map((f) => Number(f.file_id));
  const holding = new Set();
  for (const { boundary_entry_id: e } of s.leafBoundaries.all(transcriptPk)) {
    const f = pickHoldingCopy(live.map((id) => ({ fileId: id, live: true, holds: s.member.get(id, e) !== undefined })));
    if (f !== null) holding.add(f);
  }
  const { unspanned, forked } = forkCounts({
    liveSizes: live.map((f) => Number(s.copySize.get(f).n)),
    unionSize: Number(s.rowsIn.get(JSON.stringify(live)).n),
    coveredSize: Number(s.rowsIn.get(JSON.stringify([...holding])).n),
    holdingCopies: holding.size,
  });
  const prev = foldedOf(getStep(db, UNSPANNED_STEP, transcriptPk));
  const marked = getStep(db, FORKED_STEP, transcriptPk) !== null;
  withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => {
    if (unspanned > prev.unspanned) bump(db, 'rows_unspanned', unspanned - prev.unspanned);
    setStep(db, UNSPANNED_STEP, transcriptPk, `${unspanned}:${bytes}`);
    if (forked && !marked) { bump(db, 'transcript_forked'); setStep(db, FORKED_STEP, transcriptPk, '1', nowMs); }
  });
}

/** Every boundary without its leaf, in entry order, within the run's budget (§9.2 step 6); then the fork counts
 *  of every main transcript with two or more live copies whose bytes read changed, or which gained a leaf.
 *  - A throw inside the parser is deriveOne's: the leaf is written parse-failed (RB5).
 *  - A throw before a leaf can be written (span planning, an insert refused) counts parser_crash once and leaves a
 *    ('leaf-crashed', entry_id) marker at this NODE_PARSER_VERSION, in one transaction: the todo queries skip the
 *    boundary, so the cursor moves past it and no tick parses it again. Reparse clears the markers (Task 21); a new
 *    NODE_PARSER_VERSION retries them. D-4706 (history-parser-crash-recorded)
 *  - A busy store ends the tick, as ingest's does.
 *  The cursor ('leaves', NODE_PARSER_VERSION) is the low-water mark: every boundary at or below it has its leaf or a
 *  crash marker, and a boundary that waits holds it. */
export function deriveLeaves(db, ictx, budget) {
  ensureNodeIndexes(db);
  const s = stmts(db);
  const kit = ictx.nodeKit ?? nodeToolkit();
  const crashedAt = String(NODE_PARSER_VERSION);
  const low = Number(getStep(db, LEAF_STEP, NODE_PARSER_VERSION)?.cursor ?? 0);
  const pass = { copy: null, epochs: new Map(), files: new Map() };
  const touched = new Set();
  let derived = 0;
  let waiting = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  for (const b of s.todo.all(low, LEAF_CRASHED_STEP, crashedAt)) {
    if (!ictx.budgetLeft(budget)) break;
    let r;
    try {
      r = deriveOne(db, ictx, kit, s, pass, b, budget);
    } catch (e) {
      if (ictx.isBusy(e)) throw e;
      withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => {
        bump(db, 'parser_crash');
        setStep(db, LEAF_CRASHED_STEP, Number(b.entry_id), crashedAt, ictx.nowMs);
      });
      r = 'failed';
    }
    if (r === 'derived') {
      derived += 1;
      touched.add(Number(b.transcript_pk));
    } else if (r === 'failed') {
      failed += 1;
    } else {
      waiting += 1;
    }
  }
  for (const c of s.forkCandidates.all()) {
    if (!ictx.budgetLeft(budget)) break;
    const pk = Number(c.transcript_pk);
    const bytes = Number(c.bytes);
    if (touched.has(pk) || foldedOf(getStep(db, UNSPANNED_STEP, pk)).bytes !== bytes) recountTranscript(db, s, pk, ictx.nowMs, bytes);
  }
  const first = s.firstTodo.get(low, LEAF_CRASHED_STEP, crashedAt).e;
  const top = first === null ? Number(s.lastBoundary.get().e ?? low) : Number(first) - 1;
  if (top > low) withTx(db, 'NORMAL', () => { setStep(db, LEAF_STEP, NODE_PARSER_VERSION, String(top)); });
  return { derived, waiting, failed };
}

/** Derive, nodes (§9.2 step 6, §6.3). Task 9 adds the parents and the nodes_fts backfill after the leaves. */
export function deriveNodes(db, ictx, budget) {
  deriveLeaves(db, ictx, budget);
}
```

  - The `\n` in comments are two-character escapes in source, never raw control bytes. `derive.mjs` spells no dedupe key of its own: `capRefs` is the one (kind, value) rule.
  - `derive.mjs` reads no `process.env` and declares none of the O14 vocabularies, so B1's single-definition scans over `ccd/history/*.mjs` hold. Its status words (`not-requested`, `parse-failed`) are `PARSE_STATUS` words used, never a list declared.
  - `json_each` is SQLite's built-in JSON table function. `rowsIn`, `forkCandidates` and the todo queries' marker clause were run on `node:sqlite` under Node 24 at plan time; `history-derive.test.ts` is on the node-floor leg (Step 6), so CI re-measures them on 22.16.0 (RB9). `rowsIn` counts a union of copies in SQLite rather than in a JavaScript Set, so a recount of a large forked transcript costs one indexed scan per copy list.

```bash

cat > .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/mutate.mjs <<'EOF'
// .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/mutate.mjs: measures each guard RED with it mutated, then GREEN with
// it restored (the B2 plan's mutation-pin rule). Run from server/, in the foreground, with a timeout of at least
// 600000 ms:
//   node ../.superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/mutate.mjs <mutants.json>
// A mutant is {name, file, test, filter, edits: [{anchor, replacement}]}. `file` is repo-relative, `test` is
// server/-relative, and each anchor must occur exactly once in the file as the earlier edits leave it. The
// pristine file is copied to scratch/keep/<file with '/' as '__'>.orig BEFORE it is touched, and the copy is
// removed only after the file is restored from it. A kill no handler sees therefore leaves the original findable,
// and the next run REFUSES while any copy is left. To restore by hand, from the repository root:
//   for f in .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/keep/*.orig; do t="$(basename "$f" .orig)"; cp "$f" "${t//__//}" && rm "$f"; done
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';

const KEEP = '../.superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/keep';
mkdirSync(KEEP, { recursive: true });
const left = readdirSync(KEEP).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.orig'));
if (left.length > 0) {
  console.log(`REFUSED: ${left.join(', ')} in ${KEEP}. An earlier run was interrupted and a source may hold a mutant: restore as this file's header says.`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const keepOf = (file) => `${KEEP}/${file.replaceAll('/', '__')}.orig`;
const restoreAll = () => {
  for (const n of readdirSync(KEEP)) {
    if (!n.endsWith('.orig')) continue;
    copyFileSync(`${KEEP}/${n}`, `../${n.slice(0, -'.orig'.length).replaceAll('__', '/')}`);
    rmSync(`${KEEP}/${n}`);
  }
};
// Every way out restores: the loop's end, process.exit and an uncaught throw all emit 'exit', and a signal is
// turned into an exit. A signal sent while the synchronous loop holds the thread is handled after the current
// child returns; a Ctrl-C also reaches the vitest child, and the loop stops on the child's signal below.
process.on('exit', restoreAll);
for (const s of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM', 'SIGHUP']) process.on(s, () => process.exit(130));
// maxBuffer: past Node's default (1 MiB) spawnSync kills the child (ENOBUFS, signal SIGTERM, measured), which the
// loop below reads as an interrupt. Each large-operand case asserts a boolean or a length, so a red prints no big diff.
const vitest = (test, filter) => spawnSync('./node_modules/.bin/vitest', ['run', test, '-t', filter], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 256 * 1024 * 1024 });
const mutants = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
let bad = 0;
for (const m of mutants) {
  const target = `../${m.file}`;
  if (!existsSync(target)) { console.log(`NO SUCH FILE       ${m.name}`); bad += 1; continue; }
  const keep = keepOf(m.file);
  copyFileSync(target, keep);
  let src = readFileSync(keep, 'utf8');
  let unique = true;
  for (const e of m.edits) {
    const at = src.indexOf(e.anchor);
    if (at < 0 || src.indexOf(e.anchor, at + 1) >= 0) { unique = false; break; }
    src = src.slice(0, at) + e.replacement + src.slice(at + e.anchor.length);
  }
  if (!unique) { rmSync(keep); console.log(`ANCHOR NOT UNIQUE  ${m.name}`); bad += 1; continue; }
  writeFileSync(target, src);
  const red = vitest(m.test, m.filter);
  copyFileSync(keep, target);
  rmSync(keep);
  if (red.signal !== null) { console.log(`INTERRUPTED (${red.signal})  ${m.name}`); process.exit(130); }
  const failed = /Tests\s+(\d+) failed/.exec(red.stdout)?.[1] ?? '?';
  if (red.status === 0) { console.log(`STAYED GREEN       ${m.name}`); bad += 1; } else console.log(`red (${failed} failed)   ${m.name}`);
  const green = vitest(m.test, m.filter);
  if (green.signal !== null) { console.log(`INTERRUPTED (${green.signal})  ${m.name}`); process.exit(130); }
  if (green.status !== 0) { console.log(`RED AFTER RESTORE  ${m.name}`); bad += 1; } else console.log(`green              ${m.name}`);
}
console.log(bad === 0 ? 'every guard measured red, then green' : `${bad} guard(s) not measured`);
process.exit(bad === 0 ? 0 : 1);
EOF
```

Level 0 is split per holding copy (the coordinator's ruling RB4): each epoch's boundaries, in `boundaries.ord`, go to one slot list per transcript file that holds them, and fan-in runs per list, so a parent's children always share one copy and a parent never mixes two forks.

    - `deriveNodes` now runs leaves, then parents, then `indexNodesFts`.
    - `export function rerollParents(db: DatabaseSync, ictx: { fts: boolean; pairIdx: PairIndex; nowMs: number }, nodeIds: readonly string[]): number`: every condensed node above the given nodes re-rolled from its stored children, ids kept, `nodes_fts` rows replaced when `ictx.fts`; answers how many parents it rewrote. Task 21's `reparseLeaves` and Task 29's re-derivation call it.
    - `export const NODES_FTS_STEP = 'nodes-fts'` (the backfill's step; Task 23 resets its cursor).
  - sweep.mjs: `mergeFamily` also re-points every node of either family to `(toPk, its epoch's new seq)`. A node it cannot place is counted `nodes_unrepointed`.
  - The `nodes.topics` column for a parent holds `JSON.stringify(string[])`. A `nodes_fts` row holds three redacted columns, lib's `nodeIndexTexts` of the node's stored fields: `gist`, `topics` joined by `\n`, and the ref values joined by `\n`.

**Spec:**
- Sections: §6.3 (directional edge names, lineage `ON DELETE RESTRICT`, the range CTE, fan-in 8/4, never across a /clear epoch, final leaves only, deterministic parents), §6.1 (re-keying is a merge; node ids never change), §6.2 (`nodes_fts`, redacted text; "The belt"), §8.3 (layer 4, the belt every index text carries), §6.7 (DM9, DM26), §11 (P6/P7 and refuted candidate 4: the subtree CTE toward consumers is not ported), §12.
- Pins: **DM9** and **DM26**.
- Departures:
  - B1's D-4194 (`history-rekey-merges`) (nodes follow the merged epochs).
  - D-4688 (`history-span-per-boundary-copy`) (extended to fan-in by the coordinator's ruling RB4: §6.3 groups per epoch only, and two forks of one transcript interleave in `boundaries.ord`, which is numbered per transcript in arrival order. So level 0 is split per holding copy, and a parent never takes leaves of two forks).
  - D-4703 (`history-node-indexes-by-derivation`) (NEW, shared with Task 8: v1 has no index on `nodes(boundary_entry_id)` or `node_children(child_id)`, and adding one by migration would escalate real stores to `snapshot-needs-op`).
  - D-4708 (`history-parents-cursor-by-rowid`) (NEW: §6.3 names no schedule for fan-in. A `('parents', NODE_PARSER_VERSION)` low-water mark over `nodes.rowid` revisits only epochs that gained a node, so a tick never re-walks every epoch of a large store).

```bash
// mut-after.mjs: apply ONE mutant for a mutation pin (W1-B2 plan, Tasks 9-11), in place.
// usage: node .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/mut-after.mjs <file> <anchor> <needle> <replacement> [<needle> <replacement> ...]
// For each pair, replace the FIRST occurrence of <needle> that follows the first occurrence of <anchor>.
// - The clean file is saved first to .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/<basename>.orig.
// - The script exits 1 and writes nothing when the anchor or any needle is missing, so a mutant never applies half.
// - It also exits 1 while an earlier .orig is still there (an unrestored mutant).
// Restore: mv .superpowers/sdd/history-w1-b2/scratch/<basename>.orig <file>
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
```
